description:
Turn a time from find_table_times into a link the guest taps to finish booking. This does NOT book anything: it returns a short-lived URL on the venue's own booking page, already opened at that party size and that exact sitting, where the guest enters their own details and confirms.

The venue holds the table from the moment the guest opens the link, for about ten minutes, which is what gives them time to fill the form in. Until they open it nothing is held, so give them the `url` promptly and say the table is not theirs until they do.

partySize.description: The same party size passed to find_table_times. The link opens on it.

slotToken.description: A `slotToken` from find_appointment_times or find_table_times, copied exactly. It is signed and carries the venue and the time inside the signature, so it cannot be edited, built by hand, or used at a different venue. It expires about 30 minutes after the search.

venue.description: The venue's booking slug, exactly as get_venue returned it or as it appears in the venue's own booking link: the last path segment of gaplessly.com/book/<slug>, or the first label of <slug>.gaplessly.com. Not the business name.

name: start_table_booking
title: Start a table booking
